name: Expert_AH_HM_CCI
summary: This EA uses the CCI (Commodity Channel Index) smoothed by a Moving Average as its core signal filter within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold-driven signal logic from the CH_HM_CCI indicator, with fixed lot money management and no trailing stop.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI（商品通道指数）指标经移动平均平滑后作为核心信号过滤器，在MQL5标准库Expert框架下运行。根据CH_HM_CCI指标的阈值信号逻辑开仓和平仓，采用固定手数资金管理且无追踪止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于CCI指标的动量交易，通过将CCI值经过移动平均平滑处理来减少噪音和假信号。入场条件依赖于CH_HM_CCI信号过滤器的输出值，当信号强度超过开仓阈值（默认40）时开仓，当信号强度低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），默认手数为0.1，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理通过百分比参数（默认10%）和固定手数共同控制，但实际交易量主要由固定手数决定。该EA不使用追踪止损（CTrailingNone），意味着持仓利润无法自动锁定，完全依赖信号平仓或止损/止盈水平出场。止损和止盈水平默认均设为0，意味着没有预设的止损止盈保护，风险敞口较大。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on the CCI indicator, smoothed by a Moving Average to reduce noise and false signals. Entry conditions depend on the CH_HM_CCI signal filter output, opening positions when signal strength exceeds the open threshold (default 40) and closing when it falls below the close threshold (default 20). Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, which does not dynamically adjust based on account balance. Money management is controlled by both a percentage parameter (default 10%) and fixed lot size, though actual trade volume is primarily determined by the fixed lot setting. The EA does not use any trailing stop (CTrailingNone), meaning unrealized profits cannot be automatically locked in, relying entirely on signal-based exits or stop loss/take profit levels. Both stop loss and take profit levels default to 0, meaning there is no preset risk protection, leaving the position with significant risk exposure.
pros: 使用MQL5标准库Expert框架，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
CCI经过移动平均平滑处理，能有效减少短期波动带来的假信号
信号阈值可调，允许用户根据不同市场环境灵活调整开平仓灵敏度
pros_en: Uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
CCI smoothed by Moving Average effectively reduces false signals from short-term market noise
Adjustable signal thresholds allow users to flexibly tune entry/exit sensitivity for different market conditions
cons: 止损和止盈默认均为0，持仓没有任何预设的风险保护机制
无追踪止损功能，盈利持仓无法自动锁定利润，可能面临大幅回撤
固定手数资金管理不够灵活，未根据账户规模或波动性动态调整仓位
cons_en: Both stop loss and take profit default to 0, leaving positions without any preset risk protection mechanism
No trailing stop functionality means profitable positions cannot automatically lock in gains, potentially facing significant drawdowns
Fixed lot money management is inflexible, not dynamically adjusting position size based on account size or market volatility
improvements: 添加默认止损止盈设置，确保每笔交易都有基础风险保护
引入追踪止损机制（如ATR追踪止损），在趋势延续时锁定利润同时允许利润奔跑
将固定手数替换为动态仓位管理（如基于ATR或账户权益百分比），以适应不同市场波动性
improvements_en: Add default stop loss and take profit settings to ensure every trade has baseline risk protection
Introduce a trailing stop mechanism (e.g., ATR-based trailing) to lock in profits during trend continuation while allowing profits to run
Replace fixed lot sizing with dynamic position management (e.g., ATR-based or account equity percentage) to adapt to varying market volatility

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认值均为0，交易在没有止损保护的情况下运行，极端行情可能导致巨额亏损
无追踪止损机制，盈利仓位可能因市场反转而回吐全部利润
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit both default to 0, trading without stop protection which could lead to catastrophic losses during extreme market moves
No trailing stop mechanism means winning positions may give back all profits on market reversals

It opens and closes positions based on threshold-driven signal logic from the CH_HM_CCI indicator, with fixed lot money management and no trailing stop.
